title: Classical Dances of India: The Recognised Forms, Their States and How to Tell Them Apart
seoTitle: Classical Dances of India: 8 or 9? List, States, Clues
seoDescription: India has 8 classical dances recognised by Sangeet Natak Akademi; the Ministry of Culture also lists Chhau. See states, music and how to tell them apart.
excerpt: Why some lists say eight and others nine, when Sattriya got classical status, and a costume, music and footwork table that helps you recognise each dance on stage.
